mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.employee_id, e.name, e.employee_no, m.old_mobile, m.new_mobile, m.reason, m.status, m.created_at FROM employee_mobile_change_application m LEFT JOIN employee e ON m.employee_id = e.id WHERE m.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT m.id, m.employee_id, e.name, e.employee_no, m.old_mobile, m.new_mobile, m.reason, m.status, m.created_at FROM employee_mobile_change_application m LEFT JOIN employee e ON m.employee_id = e.id WHERE m.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
